notes.title: Realm of Dread v1.0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This new patch brings:

[list]
[*] Mouse Smoothing feature has been removed, allowing players to perform mouse movements more quickly.
[*] Removed the “Use AI voice acting?” question on first launch and set to enabled by default. You can change this setting in Audio Settings.
[*] Prologue has been expanded.
[*] The pace has been increased in Chapter I.
[*] New voice lines have been added to Chapter I.
[*] Added missing windows to Player's house in Chapter I.
[*] Reduced damage from flames in Chapter I.
[*] The pace has been increased in Chapter II.
[*] A missing Turkish localization for a specific note in Chapter II has been fixed.
[*] Added a marker for the book in Chapter II to prevent players losing it*
[*] The duration of the defense in Chapter III has been reduced.
[*] Fixed an enemy AI sometimes staying alive after defense ends in Chapter III.
[*] Added one more coke to give temporary speed boost in Chapter III.
[*] Fixed an issue where the environment would suddenly darken when approaching the Trainyard in Chapter III.
[*] Better and improved puzzle in the Trainyard.
[*] New voice lines have been added to Chapter III.
[*] Fixed a bug in Sewers level that caused the player to hear an underwater sound even when they were not in the water.
[*] Fixed a bug in Chapter IV that caused the player to collide with the generator and change its location.
[*] The pace has been increased in Chapter VI.
[/list]

*I'm aware of a bug where the marker doesn't appear exactly on the book, I'll work on it in the next update.

You can report bugs or send your feedback via Steam Discussions, Discord or an e-mail!

E-Mail: support@deltabright.com

Discord: https://discord.gg/hg2A3bPb3h

notes.title: Realm of Dread v1.0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This new patch brings:

[list]
[*] Added Simplified Chinese localization.
[*] Added AI powered English voice acting. When players launch the game, they will be asked if they want this feature or not for one time. You can always change this option in Audio Settings.
[*] Added a missing tutorial for climbing small ladders in Chapter IV.

[*] Changed flashlight lighting diameter (cone) to be smaller. It was a community request due to eye discomfort in interiors.
[*] Changed (reduced) waiting time to get hints for the hidden key in Chapter II.
[*] Changed AI behaviour in Chapter II to make it stay at home in the early stages.

[*] Fixed players hearing a sound of falling on a grass and screen shake in the Main Menu.
[*] Fixed body parts falling under the asphalt roads.
[*] Fixed some missing translations related to AIs.
[*] Fixed AI seeing through windows in Chapter II.
[*] Fixed a trigger that wasn't supposed to be triggered before certain events in Chapter II.
[*] Fixed a missing mission description in Chapter II.
[*] Fixed an invisible collision issue in Chapter II.
[*] Fixed a missing mission description in Chapter VII.
[*] Fixed a bug causing inventory items to get gliched in Chapter VII.
[/list]

You can report bugs or send your feedback via Steam Discussions, Discord or an e-mail!

E-Mail: support@deltabright.com

Discord: https://discord.gg/hg2A3bPb3h

notes.title: Realm of Dread v1.0.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This new patch brings:

[list]
[*] Changed "Video Settings" title to "Display Settings" under Settings menu.
[*] Added a new setting called "Health Bar Visibility" under Display Settings. This setting has two options. Default selection is "In Inventory", which you can see your health bar only in your inventory. It's best for players who like a clean HUD. Second option is "Always", which will make health bar always visible on the screen.
[*] Added notification when applied settings.
[*] Added a new activity in Chapter II.
[*] Added a new Steam achievement "SCORE!".
[*] Fixed an issue occured after using the "quick heal" feature preventing some events to be triggered, which came with the previous update.
[/list]
You can report bugs or send your feedback via Steam Discussions, Discord or an e-mail!

E-Mail: support@deltabright.com

Discord: https://discord.gg/hg2A3bPb3h

notes.title: Realm of Dread v1.0.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This new patch brings:

[list]
[*] Players will now be able to use "E" button to interact with objects.
[*] Players will now be able to use "ESC" key to close their inventory and and go back in the menus.
[*] Players will now be able to use "ENTER" key to Apply Settings in Settings menus.
[*] Players will now be able to use "R" key to reload camera battery when using the night vision camera and current battery level is below 5%. Players still can reload a new camera battery through inventory.
[*] Added notification popup upon applying settings.
[*] Minor visual changes in Settings menu.
[*] Fixed camera showing wrong direction when waiting for some time in the main menu.
[*] Improved player guidence in Trainyard chapter.
[*] Fixed players being positioned in the wrong place after climbing the hatch ladder in Trainyard chapter.
[*] Minor tutorial changes in Prologue chapter according to the new key bindings.
[/list]
You can report bugs or send your feedback via Steam Discussions, Discord or an e-mail!

E-Mail: support@deltabright.com

Discord: https://discord.gg/hg2A3bPb3h
